records.label: Gemma 4 12B: H100 vs Ascend TP1 text pilot (one input) · GPU/NPU: h100-r1 vs npu-r1

metrics.label: Top-100 union plus complement JS mean
Top-100 union plus complement JS P99
Top-100 union plus complement JS max

records.scope: One fixed input, two distinct serial TP1 captures; 32 paired targets and 32 complete-vocabulary prediction rows. Anonymous target and prediction indices start separately at zero. Pair repetitions share the same input.
notes: Thresholds and numerical acceptance remain null. This is a partial single-input integration pilot; full-core completion is false.

Nine cross pairs reuse the same input and only three captures per backend; they are not nine independent examples. All six within-backend pairs had equal recorded target values and equal full-row hash vectors for this request, without a general determinism claim.

The source-side gate checked all 192 full rows. The separate standard-library E02 check reconstructed all 15 target comparisons and only the 32 distribution positions of the prespecified h100-r1/npu-r1 pair; deduplicated global maxima already lay in that pair. It did not independently replay all 192 distribution rows.

The delivery machine separately holds 96 GPU full rows and zero NPU full rows. The imported metadata export contains zero NPY files. Public replay reads zero full rows and reproduces only the 15 recorded target comparisons; distribution summaries are archived source-side results.

JS is natural-log divergence on the top-100 union plus one exact complement category. Probability RMSE and maximum probability error cover union tokens only. Quantiles are linear across 32 positions. Arithmetic tolerance 1e-12 and normalization tolerance 1e-5 are verification tolerances, not accuracy acceptance thresholds.

Target maximum uses anonymous target index 25; JS maximum uses anonymous prediction index 26; probability RMSE/maximum-error maxima use prediction index 31. Target and prediction offsets are distinct.
Archive replay_cases=15 counts capture-pair target reductions, not independent inputs.

The coverage ledger retains all 49 original tasks and 28 core tasks. Cache-off/chunk/batch/padding contrasts, representative/reserved inputs, internal/operator attribution, generation quality, performance and complete cost accounting remain open. Driver metadata handling is not a numerical repair.

common_conditions: Same pinned base checkpoint and frozen input SHA256 643d29f23d00f97665c5c72d73c63bc20525950b2ca5c50b435140b6066214f0; one independent unpadded 128-token conditioning history including BOS and 32 predetermined continuation targets.

BF16 parameters/native logits, eager attention, seed 0, cache-on TP1; one prefill plus 31 single-token cached forwards per capture. Offline FP64 log-softmax of copied BF16 values; original native logits were not retained.
Three fresh serial processes per backend. Source comparison checked 96 complete 262144-entry rows per backend and all 15 capture-pair comparisons.
differences: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 versus Ascend910_9382. GPU instance exposed one device; NPU instance exposed eight, with only one used per capture. No TP8 or distributed-model claim.

PyTorch 2.9.0+cu128/CUDA 12.8 versus PyTorch 2.9.0+cpu with TorchNPU 2.9.0.post2/CANN 9.1.0; Transformers 5.10.1 on both. GPU driver 580.95.05 is separate supplementary inventory; NPU driver 25.5.2 is pinned installed-package metadata after the recorded metadata API decode failure.

Highest FP32 matmul precision with matmul TF32/HF32 disabled and convolution TF32/HF32 enabled. GPU cuDNN deterministic/benchmark flags were false; NPU JIT compilation was disabled and cube math type was unavailable. Exact per-backend policies remain recorded; differences do not identify a causal operator defect.

records.label: Gemma 4 12B text pilot: H100 vs RTX 5090 · H100 vs RTX 5090: first captures

metrics.label: Top-100 union plus tail JS mean
Top-100 union plus tail JS max

records.scope: First capture on each side; one discovery input and fixed continuation history. Target positions 128-159; distribution prediction positions 127-158. P99 is linear at 0.99*(N-1). JS compares the top-100 union plus a merged tail; probability RMSE is over union tokens only.
notes: Thresholds and numerical acceptance are null; completion of these measurements is not a pass/fail decision or causal diagnosis.

Each device has three within-side run pairs; all recorded target MAE and maximum errors and coarsened JS are zero, with top-1 agreement 32/32 in each pair. This is a one-input observation, not a general determinism guarantee.
Only the 32 paired target scores and their MAE, P99, max and NLL are publicly replayable; top-1 and distribution summaries rely on retained private derived rows.

16个native作业；第16层双端完成模型计算后CPU后处理失败，单独CPU恢复通过，原失败记录保留。

common_conditions: 完整条件生成模型，9,409,813,744个基础参数，32个语言层；文本输入。
原始模型revision、输入token、mask与逻辑位置对应；离线指标使用共享比较工具。
differences: 各策略分别比较GPU CUDA与NPU CANN/torch-npu执行实现；策略的FP32范围在比较项中声明。

records.scope: 仅比较第 2 步。每端恢复各自的 checkpoint-1；两端起点是各自独立的第 1 步训练结果。
notes: 两端均有 128/128 份 checkpoint 参数、AdamW 动量及计数器入口数组精确一致。
H200 的 448/448 份导出数组相等；910C 为 298/448。两端各自的 20 个目标分数均与连续训练相等。
910C 的原生 microbatch loss 最大差为 5.960464477539063e-8；此处仅记录观测结果。
39 项比较与产物校验回放一致。

common_conditions: 相同模型 revision、冻结基座与分词输入；BF16 基座、FP32 LoRA，rank 8、alpha 16、dropout 0。
顺序采样，每步两个 microbatch，分别含 8 / 12 个目标；梯度累积 2，原生 loss 分母为 20。
AdamW lr=0.001，betas=(0.9,0.999)，eps=1e-8；关闭裁剪、autocast 与 gradient checkpointing。
